data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Very Unhappy!](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a2747dd816a6117851879ba)
I ordered a pair of curtains and two pillows. I received free shipping on my order. Sadly, the colors did not work right in my space, so I had to return them. I was provided a free return shipping label. After my items were received back and my credit card was refunded, I was shocked to see that they deducted $253.03 from my refund for shipping. In addition, there is no customer service phone number. You have to email them with a detailed description of your issue. They respond with an auto-generated email stating they will get back to you in 1-2 business days. Very frustrating when I needed an explanation of my charges. I have bought several items from Lulu & Georgia through the years, from furniture to accessories. Luckily, I have not needed to return anything until now. There are many online high-end home furnishings options. I will probably not order from Lulu & Georgia again! Very disappointed and unhappy.

May 27, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 9, 2026

Hi Janna,

We appreciate you sharing your feedback. We understand your frustration regarding the refund deduction and the communication process. Our Customer Experience team has reached out to your email to help clarify this situation and ensure it is resolved. Thank you for your patience.
